description:
Role: PTC Integrity Developer
Location: St Paul , MN/ Remote
Duration: 6+ Months

BGV will be done for the selected candidates.

Summary:

Seeking a PTC Integrity Developer to build high quality, user focused custom applications utilizing PTC’s software. Individual will work closely with the project team to develop PTC related software engineering applications. Individual will be responsible for developing the application based on the design process for the specific engineering problem/task/requirements.



Responsibilities:



1. Responsible for Configuration, Change and Delivery management in PTC Integrity

2. Develop; design, plan and implements process systems and procedures utilizing standard engineering or technical principles.

3. Continuous improvement of the PTC Integrity configuration and change management processes

4. Migration experience from DOORS to PTC integrity

5. Prepare company standards and procedures supporting automated design projects.

6. Prioritize project and support activities to meet strategic directives and/or deployments per project requirements.

7. Conducts tool training and support all project team members in the use of tools and processes and identify improvement potential.



Qualifications and Experience:

· Must have an experience with the latest PTC - integrity tools and PTC data management software package.

· Must have excellent software design and programming skills using C/C++, Java and VB/VBA

· Proficient experience using Microsoft Office suite and CM engineering tools such as PTC Integrity, Windchill or similar

· Ability to work collaboratively with design department, engineering, development team

· Excellent and oral communication skills
